explanation: The requested cos(theta*) endpoints -1 and +1 are physically within the requested scan but cannot be evaluated by EXCLURAD because the integration fails at the exact poles. They were corrected to -0.999 and +0.999, the validated convention; the intermediate points remain -0.5, 0, and +0.5. Input generation passed preflight for all five corrected points. Full O(alpha) mode was used with the eta campaign default beam energy 6.53 GeV and vcut 0.166 GeV^2.
